sample: Replay of the real Treasury series with an assumed $100/day fee inflow at a $0.001 token price. No transactions exist. Built by site/deficit/sample/make-sample.mjs.

rules.statement: Every full $1,000,000,000 added to the U.S. Total Public Debt Outstanding (Treasury's Debt to the Penny) since the previous business day's reading is one unit. Remainders under $1B carry forward only across consecutive increases; a day the debt falls or stays flat counts nothing and resets the remainder to zero. On each day with units, the keeper spends 1 - 0.95^units of its fee pool (the token's creator-fee SOL plus a disclosed seed, less a 0.02 SOL fee reserve) buying $DEFICIT at market on the public pool, and burns every token it receives in the next transaction. Days that would spend under $1 buy nothing. The keeper never sells and never sends tokens anywhere but the burn.
